selection_rule: All four already observed P18 development cases in original order, including two successes. No reserved tasks or answer-derived targets.
server_lease_basis: Same M3 server; at least 8100 live seconds before four tasks.
scope: Ordinary code-action comparator, all four known development tasks, one seed; photo API budget matches P26, others P25. No new method or confirmatory claim.
discovery_policy: Initially api_docs and supervisor schemas. A requested app description exposes that public app; individual API documentation exposes that API. New schemas apply on the next model response. No answer-based selection or silent top-k pruning.
interpretation: CodeAct-inspired public API Python interface; not a full reproduction of the original agent.
Code control flow, schema presentation and observation selection differ from native calls.
Every inner API request is charged; no known failure excluded and no retry.
Fresh Python variables per program; prior public receipts available by ID.
history_representation: Append-only public assistant content/calls and tool observations; no reasoning replay. Same archive page size. Invalid argument turns use text fallback preserving raw calls and actual results.
